## Memo derived metadata

### Computation site / call chain

**Persisted payload (tags + property)** — single write path:

1. **`memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload`** — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-87`  
   Calls `markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))` and writes only:
   - `memo.Payload.Tags`
   - `memo.Payload.Property`  
   Does **not** touch `memo.Payload.Location` (user-set).

2. **`markdown.Service.ExtractAll`** — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356-422`  
   One goldmark AST walk (GFM + custom tag/mention extensions). Populates `ExtractedData`:

```20:25:internal/markdown/markdown.go
type ExtractedData struct {
	Tags     []string
	Mentions []string
	Property *storepb.MemoPayload_Property
}
```

3. **Tag lexer** — `internal/markdown/parser/tag.go:79-149` (`#tag`, skips headings/links/images).  
4. **Mention lexer** — `internal/markdown/parser/mention.go:39+` (`@username`, skips emails).

**Read-time / response-only** (not stored in `memo.payload`):

| Derived field | Function | Path |
|---|---|---|
| `Memo.snippet` | `getMemoContentSnippet` → `GenerateSnippet(content, 64)` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-89`, set in `memo_service_converter.go:76-80` |
| `MemoRelation.Memo/RelatedMemo.snippet` | same | `memo_relation_service.go:154-164`, `memo_service_converter.go:224-252` |
| Notification snippets | `memoNotificationSnippet` → `getMemoContentSnippet` | `user_service_notifications.go:318-327` |
| `@mentions` (notifications only) | `resolveMentionTargets` → `ExtractAll` | `memo_mention_helpers.go:32-35` |
| RSS item title | `generateItemTitle` (first line, strip `#` headings) | `server/router/rss/rss.go:302-335` |

`GenerateSnippet` logic: `internal/markdown/markdown.go:263-346` (plain text, skips fenced code blocks, 64-char word-boundary truncate).

---

### Operations that trigger recomputation (production)

#### Persisted payload (`tags`, `property`) — **only on content write**

| Operation | Trigger | Lines |
|---|---|---|
| **`CreateMemo`** | Always, before DB insert | `memo_service.go:108-110` |
| **`CreateMemoComment`** | Indirect — calls `CreateMemo` internally | `memo_service_comments.go:56-59` → `memo_service.go:108` |
| **`UpdateMemo`** | **Only** when `update_mask` contains `"content"` | `memo_service.go:436-451` |
| MCP / Connect / gRPC-Gateway | Same RPCs above | `server/router/mcp/catalog.go` |

#### Read-time snippet / mentions — **on every response that needs them**

Recomputed whenever memos are converted for API/RSS/notifications (no DB write): `ListMemos`, `GetMemo`, `ListMemoComments`, `ListMemoRelations`, `SetMemoRelations` response build, inbox notifications, etc.

#### Batch maintenance runner (not wired to server)

`memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:26-72` — would rebuild all memo payloads, but **no `NewRunner` / startup hook** exists (`server/server.go` only starts `s3presign`). Not an automatic production path.

---

### Operations that do **not** recompute persisted payload

`UpdateMemo` paths that skip `RebuildMemoPayload` (`memo_service.go:452-493`):

- `visibility`, `pinned`, `state`
- `create_time`, `update_time`
- `location` — updates `payload.Location` directly (`482-484`), no content parse
- `attachments` — `setMemoAttachmentsInternal`
- `relations` — `setMemoRelationsInternal`

Also no payload rebuild: `SetMemoRelations`, `SetMemoAttachments`, `DeleteMemo`, reactions, shares, pin-only updates.

---

### Extracted / derived properties

#### Stored in `memo.payload` (proto: `proto/store/memo.proto:7-28`)

| Field | Source | Extraction rule |
|---|---|---|
| **`tags`** | `ExtractAll` | `#tag` tokens via tag parser; deduped, case preserved; skipped inside links/images (`markdown.go:376-378`, `122-140`) |
| **`property.has_link`** | AST `KindLink` | Any markdown link (`markdown.go:393-394`) |
| **`property.has_code`** | Code nodes | `CodeBlock`, `FencedCodeBlock`, `CodeSpan` (`396-397`) |
| **`property.has_task_list`** | GFM task checkbox | `east.KindTaskCheckBox` (`399-400`) |
| **`property.has_incomplete_tasks`** | Unchecked checkbox | `!checkBox.IsChecked` (`401-404`) |
| **`property.title`** | First block child of doc | Text of first H1 only (`383-388`) |

Exposed on API as `Memo.tags`, `Memo.property` (`proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:240-256`, `271-279`); filterable via CEL (`internal/filter/schema.go:173-229`).

#### API output only (computed at read, not in `payload`)

| Field | Max length | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **`snippet`** | 64 chars | Plain-text preview (`memo_service.proto:265-266`) |
| **Relation snippets** | 64 chars | Per related memo (`memo_service.proto:443-444`) |
| **Notification snippets** | 64 chars | `memo_snippet`, `related_memo_snippet` |
| **`mentions`** | — | Extracted by `ExtractAll` for inbox side effects only; **not** stored on memo |

#### Not content-derived (user / explicit API)

- **`location`** — user-set (`memo.proto:24-28`, `memo_service.go:111-113`, `481-484`)
- **`relations`** — explicit `SetMemoRelations` / comment creation; **not** parsed from markdown
- **`attachments`**, **`reactions`**, **`pinned`**, **`visibility`**, timestamps

---

### Create vs update vs unrelated

```
CREATE (any memo, including comments)
  content → RebuildMemoPayload → persist tags + property
  optional user location applied after rebuild (memo_service.go:111-113)

UPDATE content (update_mask: "content")
  content → RebuildMemoPayload → persist tags + property
  + mention notification diff (memo_service.go:510-512)

UPDATE unrelated fields
  location / visibility / pinned / state / timestamps / attachments / relations
  → no RebuildMemoPayload; location patches payload.Location only

READ (list/get/relations/notifications/RSS)
  snippet (+ relation snippets, mention resolution) computed fresh from content
  tags/property read from stored payload
```

**Summary:** Persisted derived metadata = **`tags` + `property`** (5 booleans/strings), rebuilt only on **create** and **content update**. **`snippet`** and **mentions** are derived at serve time. **Relations** and **location** are not content-derived.
